subject: possibility to evaluate the logL of a glmmTMB model with user-specified parameter values

messages.author: 92a4ecc1b799a693
messages.subject: possibility to evaluate the logL of a glmmTMB model with user-specified parameter values
parts:
Dear all,

Is there a convenient way to supply user-specified parameter values to a glmmTMB model to get the logLikelihood of the model with the user-specified parameter values?

e.g something like this: 
glmmTMB(y ~ x+z+d+(1|Site),family=Poisson, parvalues = list(fixed, random))

Thanks a lot!

cheers, Bob Douma

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] possibility to evaluate the logL of a glmmTMB model with user-specified parameter values
parts:
I'll just point out the "where to ask about glmmTMB?" link is here:

https://github.com/glmmTMB/glmmTMB/#where-to-ask-questions

Once you have fitted a model you can find the negative log-likelihood
function via $obj$fn() :

glmmTMB(formula = count ~ mined + (1 | site), data = Salamanders,
family = poisson, ziformula = ~mined, dispformula = ~1)

names(m1$obj$par)
## [1] "beta" "beta" "betazi" "betazi" "theta"

m1$obj$fn(c(1,1,0,0,1))
[1] 992.6808
